observed.rule: every arm ID on every control
exactly one of E1, E2 reproduces the loss (>=2/3 repeats) and the other matches E0 (>=2/3 repeats)
decided (stop, n_min) equals decided E0 (replay) / A14 (fresh); WRONG 0; unknown allowed
mean over traces (parts a, c) of median call wall E3 / E0; 95% CI lower > 1
A15 and A15_cube equal A14 (stop, n_min) wherever A14 decides

GCLS16.rule: reported: clause and variable counts per variant and size (replays)

GPH16.rule: reported: calls and capped calls by phase (least, rival = future + start, cube) per variant / arm
